div.div:
served so far: A1: 2 A6: 2 A3: 3 A4: 3 A2: 4 A5: 4
Fewest served reaches first; ties broken by id so a fixed seed reproduces the run.
The feasibility filter is kept - an agent that does not believe it can do the task is skipped. Without it this would not be round-robin, it would be conscription.

div.div: Perfect load balance, bought by ignoring who is good at what.

div.div:
Equal task counts by construction, not on average - which is why this arm is the reference
for the two fairness metrics: the Gini coefficient of task counts, and the weakest agent's
longest idle streak. Nothing else in the arm set is trying to be fair, so without P8 there
is no reference for what fairness costs. P4_RANDOM is this same picture with the pointer
replaced by a uniform draw: equal counts on average rather than by construction.

div.div:
Same job, same DAG, same READY rule, same one-task-per-agent limit, same belt.
Everything above the belt is copied from the ConveyorFlow sheets unchanged.
collision_rate = 0 on every sheet in this family, and that is not an efficiency
result: nobody contends because somebody already decided.
